description: This file manages subagent control operations including listing, killing, steering, and messaging for subagents within a larger system. It handles session resolution, control scope enforcement, and interaction with external gateway methods.

methods.name: resolveStorePathForKey
methods.description: Resolves the store path for a given session key based on configuration and parsed session key.

methods.name: resolveSessionEntryForKey
methods.description: Resolves and caches the session entry for a given session key.

methods.name: resolveSubagentController
methods.description: Determines the subagent controller session and capabilities based on provided session key.

methods.name: listControlledSubagentRuns
methods.description: Lists the latest subagent runs controlled by a specific session key.

methods.name: buildLatestSubagentRunIndex
methods.description: Builds an index of latest subagent runs by child session key and controller.

methods.name: createPendingDescendantCounter
methods.description: Creates a function to count pending descendant runs for a session key, with caching.

methods.name: isActiveSubagentRun
methods.description: Checks if a subagent run is active based on its end time and pending descendants.

methods.name: resolveRunStatus
methods.description: Determines the status string of a subagent run based on its record and pending descendants.

methods.name: resolveModelRef
methods.description: Resolves the model reference for a session entry with fallback.

methods.name: resolveModelDisplay
methods.description: Resolves the display name for a session entry with fallback.

methods.name: buildListText
methods.description: Builds a textual summary of active and recent subagents.

methods.name: buildSubagentList
methods.description: Constructs a list of subagents with detailed info, including active and recent runs.

methods.name: ensureControllerOwnsRun
methods.description: Checks if a controller owns a specific subagent run.

methods.name: killSubagentRun
methods.description: Terminates a specific subagent run and updates session store.

methods.name: cascadeKillChildren
methods.description: Recursively kills child subagent runs and collects labels.

methods.name: killAllControlledSubagentRuns
methods.description: Kills all subagent runs controlled by a specific controller within scope.

methods.name: killControlledSubagentRun
methods.description: Kills a specific subagent run if controlled by the controller, including descendants.

methods.name: killSubagentRunAdmin
methods.description: Admin endpoint to kill a subagent run by session key, including descendants.

methods.name: steerControlledSubagentRun
methods.description: Sends a steer command to a controlled subagent run, possibly restarting it.

methods.name: sendControlledSubagentMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to a controlled subagent run and waits for reply.

methods.name: resolveControlledSubagentTarget
methods.description: Resolves a subagent target from runs and token, with options.

methods.name: __testing.setDepsForTest
methods.description: Sets dependencies for testing purposes, overriding callGateway.
